target_customer: University tech transfer, corporate relations and advancement offices that pay for partnership prospecting
problem: Universities struggle to find industry partners for research; FirstIgnite uses AI and data to prospect companies and manage partnerships.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription sold to universities and research institutions
product_category: Business development and CRM for research institutions

founders.name: Chase Bonhag
founders.background_notes: VC investor in university research and corporate innovation.

technical_complexity.rationale: Data aggregation, matching and CRM features on web stack; AI agents added later.

defensibility.rationale: A niche customer base and accumulated partnership data help, but the market is small and tech transfer vendors can add similar tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Inteum integrated with FirstIgnite and, after Merit Holdings bought Inteum in 2025, Merit acquired FirstIgnite in early 2026.

market_need_then: Universities were pushed to commercialize research and find corporate partners, but tech transfer offices had limited tools; commentary notes the category is small.

identity.logo: Trademark filed March 2019 as F I FIRSTIGNITE design mark

branding.community_and_virality: Per-university branded subdomains (for example msu.firstignite.com) used with customers.

brand_strength.rationale: Known within a niche; no press on the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: FirstIgnite, founded in 2019 by a former university-research VC and a UIUC engineer, sold prospecting and CRM tools to universities and went through YC in Summer 2021. It stayed small and was acquired by Merit Holdings in February 2026, which had bought Inteum in 2025. The price and funding history are not public in sources found, and commentary notes the market size is a limit.
notes: Funding unverified: Seedtable lists a 2020 seed of about 200K (Red Cedar Ventures) and a March 2024 seed (Michigan Rise), AI Market Watch says 1.23M total, CB Insights says 150K; these conflict and are aggregator only, so no rounds recorded. YC page says the deal was all cash; I found no outlet confirming. Acquisition date Feb 2026 (Taft release 18 Feb; Seedtable says 5 Feb). Competition empty: only current-era results found (Wellspring, Inteum).
